   369→                                       _ isOutgoing: Bool,
   370→                                       _ edited: Bool) -> RoomTimelineItemProtocol {
   371→        let allVotes = votes.reduce(0) { count, pair in
   372→            count + pair.value.count
   373→        }
   374→
   375→        let maxOptionVotes = votes.map(\.value.count).max()
   376→
   377→        let options = answers.map { answer in
   378→            let optionVotesCount = votes[answer.id]?.count
   379→            
   380→            return Poll.Option(id: answer.id,
   381→                               text: answer.text,
   382→                               votes: optionVotesCount ?? 0,
   383→                               allVotes: allVotes,
   384→                               isSelected: votes[answer.id]?.contains(userID) ?? false,
   385→                               isWinning: optionVotesCount.map { $0 == maxOptionVotes } ?? false)
   386→        }
   387→        
   388→        let pollKind: Poll.Kind = switch pollKind {

   394→

   400→                        endDate: endTime.map { Date(timeIntervalSince1970: TimeInterval($0 / 1000)) },

   402→
   403→        return PollRoomTimelineItem(id: eventItemProxy.id,

   436→    private func buildEncryptedTimelineItem(_ eventItemProxy: EventTimelineItemProxy,
   437→                                            _ messageLikeContent: MsgLikeContent,
   438→                                            _ encryptedMessage: EncryptedMessage,
   439→                                            _ isOutgoing: Bool) -> RoomTimelineItemProtocol {
   440→        var encryptionType = EncryptedRoomTimelineItem.EncryptionType.unknown
   441→        var errorLabel = L10n.commonWaitingForDecryptionKey
   442→        switch encryptedMessage {
   443→        case .megolmV1AesSha2(let sessionID, let cause):
   444→            switch cause {
   445→            case .unknown:
   446→                encryptionType = .megolmV1AesSha2(sessionID: sessionID, cause: .unknown)
   447→                errorLabel = L10n.commonWaitingForDecryptionKey
   448→            case .verificationViolation:
   449→                encryptionType = .megolmV1AesSha2(sessionID: sessionID, cause: .verificationViolation)
   450→                errorLabel = L10n.commonUnableToDecryptVerificationViolation
   451→            case .unsignedDevice, .unknownDevice:
   452→                encryptionType = .megolmV1AesSha2(sessionID: sessionID, cause: .insecureDevice)
   453→                errorLabel = L10n.commonUnableToDecryptInsecureDevice
   454→            case .sentBeforeWeJoined:
   455→                encryptionType = .megolmV1AesSha2(sessionID: sessionID, cause: .sentBeforeWeJoined)
   456→                errorLabel = L10n.commonUnableToDecryptNoAccess
   457→            case .historicalMessageAndBackupIsDisabled:
   458→                encryptionType = .megolmV1AesSha2(sessionID: sessionID, cause: .historicalMessageAndBackupDisabled)
   459→                errorLabel = L10n.timelineDecryptionFailureHistoricalEventNoKeyBackup
   460→            case .historicalMessageAndDeviceIsUnverified:
   461→                encryptionType = .megolmV1AesSha2(sessionID: sessionID, cause: .historicalMessageAndDeviceIsUnverified)
   462→                errorLabel = L10n.timelineDecryptionFailureHistoricalEventUnverifiedDevice
   463→            case .withheldForUnverifiedOrInsecureDevice:
   464→                encryptionType = .megolmV1AesSha2(sessionID: sessionID, cause: .withheldForUnverifiedOrInsecureDevice)
   465→                errorLabel = L10n.timelineDecryptionFailureWithheldUnverified
   466→            case .withheldBySender:
   467→                encryptionType = .megolmV1AesSha2(sessionID: sessionID, cause: .witheldBySender)
   468→                errorLabel = L10n.timelineDecryptionFailureUnableToDecrypt
   469→            }
   470→        case .olmV1Curve25519AesSha2(let senderKey):
   471→            encryptionType = .olmV1Curve25519AesSha2(senderKey: senderKey)
   472→        case .unknown:
   473→            break
   474→        }
   475→        
   476→        return EncryptedRoomTimelineItem(id: eventItemProxy.id,
   477→                                         body: errorLabel,
   478→                                         encryptionType: encryptionType,
   479→                                         timestamp: eventItemProxy.timestamp,
   480→                                         isOutgoing: isOutgoing,
   481→                                         isEditable: eventItemProxy.isEditable,
   482→                                         canBeRepliedTo: eventItemProxy.canBeRepliedTo,
   483→                                         sender: eventItemProxy.sender,
   484→                                         properties: .init(replyDetails: buildTimelineItemReplyDetails(messageLikeContent.inReplyTo),
   485→                                                           isThreaded: messageLikeContent.threadRoot != nil,
   486→                                                           threadSummary: buildTimelineItemThreadSummary(messageLikeContent.threadSummary)))
   487→    }

   628→    private func buildAggregatedReactions(_ reactions: [Reaction]) -> [AggregatedReaction] {
   629→        reactions.map { reaction in
   630→            let senders = reaction.senders
   631→                .map { senderData in
   632→                    ReactionSender(id: senderData.senderId, timestamp: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: TimeInterval(senderData.timestamp / 1000)))
   633→                }
   634→                .sorted { a, b in
   635→                    // Sort reactions within an aggregation by timestamp descending.
   636→                    // This puts the most recent at the top, useful in cases like the
   637→                    // reaction summary view.
   638→                    a.timestamp > b.timestamp
   639→                }
   640→            return AggregatedReaction(accountOwnerID: userID, key: reaction.key, senders: senders)
   641→        }
   642→        .sorted { a, b in
   643→            // Sort aggregated reactions by count and then timestamp ascending, using
   644→            // the most recent reaction in the aggregation(hence index 0).
   645→            // This appends new aggregations on the end of the reaction layout
   646→            // and the deterministic sort avoids reactions jumping around if the reactions timeline
   647→            // view reloads.
   648→            if a.count == b.count {
   649→                return a.senders[0].timestamp < b.senders[0].timestamp
   650→            }
   651→            return a.count > b.count
   652→        }
   653→    }

   102→    /// and its associated details or any resulting error
   103→    func processMedia(at urls: [URL], maxUploadSize: UInt) async -> Result<[MediaInfo], MediaUploadingPreprocessorError> {
   104→        await withTaskGroup { taskGroup in
   105→            for (index, url) in urls.enumerated() {
   106→                taskGroup.addTask {
   107→                    let result = await processMedia(at: url, maxUploadSize: maxUploadSize)
   108→                    return (index, result)
   109→                }
   110→            }
   111→            
   112→            // Store results in their respective index as they come in
   113→            var results = [MediaInfo?](repeating: nil, count: urls.count)
   114→            
   115→            for await (index, result) in taskGroup {
   116→                switch result {
   117→                case .success(let mediaInfo):
   118→                    results[index] = mediaInfo
   119→                case .failure(let error):
   120→                    return .failure(error)

   129→    /// from images and retrieve associated media information

   132→    func processMedia(at url: URL, maxUploadSize: UInt) async -> Result<MediaInfo, MediaUploadingPreprocessorError> {
   133→        // Start by copying the file to a unique temporary location in order to avoid conflicts if processing it multiple times
   134→        // All the other operations will be made relative to it
   135→        let uniqueFolder = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
   136→        var newURL = uniqueFolder.appendingPathComponent(url.lastPathComponent)
   137→        do {
   138→            try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: uniqueFolder, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
   139→            try FileManager.default.copyItem(at: url, to: newURL)
   140→        } catch {
   141→            return .failure(.failedProcessingMedia(error))
   142→        }

   144→        // Process unknown types as plain files
   145→        guard let type = UTType(filenameExtension: newURL.pathExtension),
   146→              let mimeType = type.preferredMIMEType else {
   147→            return processFile(at: newURL, mimeType: "application/octet-stream", maxUploadSize: maxUploadSize)
   148→        }
   149→        
   150→        if type.conforms(to: .image) {

   154→        } else if type.conforms(to: .audio) {
   155→            return await processAudio(at: newURL, mimeType: mimeType, maxUploadSize: maxUploadSize)
